reports.title: Independence Realty Trust Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance Assumptions(1)
section: Our key guidance assumptions for 2026 are enumerated below. Other than merger and integration costs incurred through September 30, 2026, our guidance does not give effect to the Proposed Transaction with Centerspace, additional merger-related transaction expenses. We expect the Proposed Transaction with Centerspace to close as early as the end of the fourth quarter of 2026 and, therefore, the impact to our full year 2026 guidance is not expected to be significant. See the definitions at the end of this release for further information regarding our same-store definitions.

(1) | This guidance, including the underlying assumptions, constitutes forward-looking information. Actual results could vary significantly from the projections presented. We undertake no duty to update the assumptions used in our guidance except as required by law. See “Forward-Looking Statements.”

(2) | Interest expense includes amortization of deferred financing costs but excludes loan premium accretion, net. As a result of purchase accounting we recorded loan premiums, net, that are accreted into and reduce GAAP interest expense over the remaining term of the associated debt. However, loan premium accretion is excluded from CFFO.

(3) | Acquisition volume reflects one property in Columbus, Ohio, acquired in Q1 and the consolidation of two properties underlying two of our joint venture investments. The consolidations of our two joint ventures were recorded on a carryover basis and occurred in Q1 and Q4. Disposition volume reflects the disposition of Stonebridge Crossing and the assumed disposition of one property classified as held for sale as of September 30, 2026. There can be no assurance that this disposition will be consummated at expected pricing levels, within expected time frames, or at all. We continue to evaluate our portfolio for capital recycling opportunities so actual acquisition and disposition volume could vary significantly from our projections.
